title: India & Germany discuss trade & technology ties in Berlin
content:
India’s Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has concluded a two-day Germany visit, with Berlin talks focused on trade, investment, advanced manufacturing, research and emerging technologies. 
He met German Federal Chancellery adviser Levin Holle and leaders from Siemens Healthineers, Bertelsmann and Volkswagen. 
Indian delegates joined sectoral roundtables with German industry.
